description: Resource type definition for AWS::DRS::RecoveryPlanExecution. A Recovery Plan execution is a single run of an AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery recovery plan, in either DRILL or RECOVERY mode. An execution is a point-in-time record of that run: it captures the plan and mode it ran with, when it started and finished, and how it ended.

RecoveryPlanExecutionArn.description: The ARN of the Recovery Plan execution.

RecoveryPlanArn.description: The ARN of the Recovery Plan that this execution ran.

Mode.description: Whether the Recovery Plan ran as a drill or as an actual recovery.

Status.description: The status of the Recovery Plan execution. Not constrained to a fixed set of values: the service documents an execution status (TIMED_OUT) that the published service model omits, so an enum here would reject a valid response.

StartedAt.description: The time at which the Recovery Plan execution started, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. The service returns an explicit UTC offset (2026-09-06T09:36:19.037172+00:00, exactly 32 characters) which the model's own ISO8601DatetimeString pattern rejects, so only the PATTERN is widened here; the length bound stays at the model's 32.

CompletedAt.description: The time at which the Recovery Plan execution reached a terminal status, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Absent while the execution is still running. The service returns an explicit UTC offset (2026-09-06T09:36:19.037172+00:00, exactly 32 characters) which the model's own ISO8601DatetimeString pattern rejects, so only the PATTERN is widened here; the length bound stays at the model's 32.

Tags.description: The tags associated with the Recovery Plan execution.
